verdict.rationale: Inngest says it handles queueing, scaling and concurrency for you with "no workers to deploy". Step checkpointing and retries let work resume after a process dies, which covers tolerance of worker loss. A community report notes Inngest runs on your own compute, so scale comes from your hosting rather than an Inngest-managed worker fleet. missing for 10: explicit documentation of horizontal scaling by adding workers or app instances, evidence of load-balancing tasks across a fleet, independent or hands-on corroboration of throughput scaling.
